items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: I worked with a fellow in New York named Billy Butler... Bill Butler directed the band, there. And I also played some gigs with him.

ctx.x: Had a lot of singing, glee clubs, you know, quartets, guys would sing in all kind of languages. Billy
Lewis, he sang in all kind of different languages. Bobby Martin and -- it was a show band.
